name: Asciioffsetbythree

description_json.name: AsciiOffsetByThree
description_json.idea: Shift the ASCII value of every character (including spaces, punctuation, and digits) forward by 3 positions for encryption, and backward by 3 positions for decryption. This ensures a simple, uniform, and completely deterministic transformation across all characters without complex conditional rules.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For each character in the text, find its ASCII code, add 3 to it, and convert it back to a character. Formula: encrypt(c) = chr(ord(c) + 3)
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each character in the text, find its ASCII code, subtract 3 from it, and convert it back to a character. Formula: decrypt(c) = chr(ord(c) - 3)

prompt:
You are an expert on a cipher called: AsciiOffsetByThree.

Cipher mechanism is the following: Shift the ASCII value of every character (including spaces, punctuation, and digits) forward by 3 positions for encryption, and backward by 3 positions for decryption. This ensures a simple, uniform, and completely deterministic transformation across all characters without complex conditional rules.

Cipher definition:
-encryption: For each character in the text, find its ASCII code, add 3 to it, and convert it back to a character. Formula: encrypt(c) = chr(ord(c) + 3)
-decryption: For each character in the text, find its ASCII code, subtract 3 from it, and convert it back to a character. Formula: decrypt(c) = chr(ord(c) - 3)
